mentions.name: Tarvis
mentions.description: A private managed cloud platform for hosting apps and running agents without needing technical knowledge. It lets users host apps on a VPS and run Claude and Codex remotely, so they don't have to keep their computer or laptop on all the time.
mentions.problem: Hosting apps normally requires technical knowledge, and running AI coding agents locally means keeping your computer or laptop on all the time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A private managed cloud to host apps and run agents.

Give it a try: https://tarvis.io

Its like coolify but cooler since you don't need any technical knowledge to host apps. You can also run claude and codex remotely on the vps without keeping your computer or laptop open all the time.
